sloka: स दर्शनीयो बहुधा विच्छिन्नः कांचनो ध्वजः ।जगाम धरणीम् सूर्यो देवतानाम् इव आज्ञया ॥३-२८-२३॥
transliteration: sa darśanīyo bahudhā vicchinnaḥ kāṁcano dhvajaḥ ।jagāma dharaṇīm sūryo devatānām iva ājñayā ॥3-28-23॥

translations.english: The beautiful, golden flag post, broken into several pieces, fell down on earth.It appeared as if the Sun had come down to earth at the behest of the gods.
